title: Você
summary: The Você tab (ADR 0112): who you are first, then the settings groups. Header with photo, name and @; Anotações; Convidar pessoas; then settings-root.

accounts.description: Accounts on this phone. The switcher section shows only when there are two or more.

isCompany.description: Company account from the Bipe API, independent of its verification badge. Selects the rounded-square avatar.

openProfile.effect: Opens the current account's profile (a later spec, Seu perfil).

shareProfile.effect: Opens the system share sheet with the bipe.chat/@handle link.

openInvites.effect: Opens the invites screen (a later spec).

openLinkPhone.effect: Opens link-phone-show (bipe_app_link_phone_action): the code that a new phone scans to move the account (ADR 0059). The only way into that flow.

openTrust.effect: Opens trust-profile from the trust card (spec trust-card).

openYearRecap.effect: Opens year-recap (ADR 0223). The row sits after the link-phone row, with bipe_year_recap_row_subtitle and the year.

notes: MZ decision 25 Oct 2026 (bipe#577): Você has no account rows. The accounts on this phone switch from the Você tab: a hold opens account-switcher, a double tap goes to the next account, and screen readers use the tab's accessibility action (app-tabs). Nova conta stays on Você, under the header.
MZ decision 25 Oct 2026 (bipe#577): the header shows the current account's avatar (photo, else initials). Since the chat list has no account avatar, Você is the one screen that shows it.
Asks (MZ, 2 Nov 2026, bipe-chat/bipe#894): Você shows no prompt cards. The photo and osTheftProtection asks are entries of chat-list-prompt, the one ask system of the app.
The header never shows the Matrix ID (ADR 0112).
The trust card (Perfil de confiança, ADR 0019) sits after Anotações: spec trust-card, which opens trust-profile.
Below the invite row comes settings-root (Configurações).

The header and account rows load the actual Matrix avatar through the SDK media API. Without a photo use initials. Shape follows ADR 0132: company is a rounded square; personal/unknown is a circle. A profile name or CNPJ badge must not determine account type.
Seu perfil (iPhone Settings layout): under the name and @, the header shows bipe_settings_profile in accent.ink with a chevron. A tap on the header opens Seu perfil.

Rows above Configurações (Anotações, Convidar pessoas, the link-phone row, the year-recap row, Meus agendamentos) use the same icon tile as settings-root. Nova conta stays an accent text action without a tile, as the iPhone's add-account rows.
A personal account has a Meus agendamentos row (bipe_agenda_my_bookings) after the year-recap row, above Configurações; it opens agenda-my-bookings. A booking list is not a setting.
